material-volume-reporting.rationale: It is repeatedly specified and is a core collection-analysis capability requiring point-in-time and category breakdown reporting.

shelf-space-utilization-report.rationale: Specified across multiple sources and required for ongoing quarterly shelf/collection management decisions.

branch-capacity-interface.rationale: Multiple sources emphasize a consortium-wide capacity view with drilldown and export, making it essential for operational planning.

item-transfer-batch-utility.rationale: High-frequency, detailed requirements (preview, permissions, audit, efficient batch execution, revert, failure handling) indicate core operational necessity.

in-transit-and-missing-damaged-reports.rationale: Cross-source requirements define configurable, operationally essential exception reporting for missing/damaged and long in-transit items.

purging-and-weeding-utility.rationale: Safety controls (previews, confirmations, audit trail, last-copy protection) and batch purge behaviors are fundamental to allowed data changes.

deletions-audit-and-reports.rationale: Deletion logging, denial tracking, and compliance-oriented reporting are repeatedly referenced and are core audit requirements.

patron-characteristics-and-demographics-.rationale: Strongly specified demographic reporting with flexible filters and explicit anonymization/privacy protections is central and highly sourced.

inactive-patrons-report.rationale: Clearly defined and well-sourced, but it can be partially worked around with more general reporting in an initial release.

uncataloged-material-inventory.rationale: Important for specific collection types and circulation statistics, but only referenced in two sources, suggesting lower criticality than core reporting.

transactions-history-and-aggregation.rationale: Core retention and aggregation requirements underpin many operational and analytical reporting needs.

detailed-transaction-counts.rationale: Multiple sources require detailed check-in/out, holds, renewals by method, and breakdowns needed for collection and operations analysis.

predefined-and-board-reports.rationale: Commonly needed governance reporting is specified multiple times, but it can be staged after core report-writing/scheduling is in place.

report-writer-features.rationale: A key capability enabling customizable queries via a web interface with saving/reuse and selection preservation is foundational.

report-templates-and-permissions.rationale: Template management with cloning and fine-grained permissions is required to safely support consistent and authorized report usage.

report-scheduling-queue-and-priority.rationale: Queueing, background execution, status visibility, cancellation, and admin prioritization are operational requirements for long-running reports.

report-output-formats-and-delivery.rationale: Multiple delivery/export formats with auditable metadata are necessary for downstream use and accessibility of reporting outputs.

real-time-and-historical-reporting.rationale: Reproducible point-in-time views via warehouse/snapshots/replicas are essential for auditability and trend analysis.

marc-and-field-level-reporting.rationale: Field-level MARC and row-collapsing requirements are explicitly needed for cataloging/collection-development and are core to report usefulness.

data-quality-reports.rationale: Important for ongoing integrity and QA, but can be delivered after the core reporting and audit/compliance features.

financial-reporting-and-ledger.rationale: Financial reports and an auditable ledger with application tracing are essential for compliance and reconciliation.

audit-and-compliance.rationale: Legal/privacy retention and audit-trail protections are stated as core system constraints that reporting must satisfy.

technical-environment-and-compatibility.rationale: Platform/DB/browser/HTML accessibility and integrity constraints are cross-cutting and necessary for the system to be deployable and safe.

non-disruptive-reporting-and-replicas.rationale: Non-disruptive background processing and optional replicas are important for operations, but a minimal approach could work initially with fewer replicas.

development-and-training-environments.rationale: Staging/migration tooling is important for rollout safety but can be partially satisfied depending on delivery timeline.

role-based-access-and-authentication.rationale: Security group/role-based access with authenticated audit logging is required to control all sensitive reporting and actions.

online-help-and-error-reporting.rationale: User support and diagnostics are widely requested but not strictly required for baseline correctness of reporting.

data-specifications-and-process-document.rationale: Complete data specifications and definitions are necessary for interoperable reporting, migration, and interpretability/auditability.

enterprise-integration-and-opac-interfer.rationale: Defines required secure integrations and explicit non-interference with OPAC performance, making it a core technical constraint.

ui-quick-access-and-tooltips.rationale: Usability improvements are helpful but less critical than core reporting/security/compliance functionality.

null-and-blank-field-handling.rationale: Correct null/blank handling is important for trustworthy reports but can be partially mitigated with documented conventions early.

survey-name-filtering.rationale: Improves usability for query authors, but functionality can proceed using internal IDs if needed.

renewal-exclusion-in-checkin-timestamps.rationale: Ensuring check-in timestamps exclude renewals is critical to prevent incorrect recency and last-seen calculations.

last-edit-date-visibility.rationale: Useful for metadata recency decisions, but less critical than core circulation-based reporting correctness.

support-large-consortium-scale.rationale: Scalability expectations and high-volume operational needs are core to system viability for the intended deployment.

standard-operational-report-templates.rationale: Built-in templates are valuable but can be added after the report writer/permissions/scheduling foundation is established.

patron-behavior-analytics.rationale: Adds advanced analytics beyond core reporting and is only specified in one source, suggesting lower priority.

overdue-items-with-contact-report.rationale: Predefined outreach-focused reporting is useful, but it is only specified in one source and could be covered by general overdue reporting.

claims-returned-report.rationale: Specific predefined report with sensitive patron details is helpful but low frequency of citation suggests later delivery.

collection-age-by-call-number.rationale: Targeted collection-development reporting is specified once and can likely be produced via flexible report writer later.

enterprise-integration-and-opac-interact.rationale: Default priority (not assigned by the model).
